questions.question: How do I choose the right course for my child?
questions.answer: We recommend starting with a free trial lesson to help us understand your child's learning style and needs. Our professional teachers will recommend the most suitable course based on the assessment results.

questions.question: Is there a fee for the trial lesson?
questions.answer: No, we offer a complimentary trial lesson to allow you and your child to experience our teaching methods and for our teachers to assess the student's learning needs.

questions.question: How are course fees calculated?
questions.answer: Course fees vary depending on the subjects and length of sessions you choose. Please contact us for the latest pricing schedule, and we also offer package discounts.

questions.question: How do I cancel or reschedule a booked lesson?
questions.answer: Please notify us at least 24 hours in advance to reschedule your lesson. Frequent cancellations may affect your priority for reserving preferred time slots.

questions.question: What subjects do you offer tutoring for?
questions.answer: We offer tutoring for all major subjects including mathematics, science, English, Chinese, and more. We also provide exam preparation courses.
